title: What are the cube roots of 27000 and 10648?
description: The cube roots of twenty seven thousand and ten thousand six hundred forty eight are found by splitting prime factors into three equal groups, as the solved example did for sixty four. The answers are then cubed to check them.
teaching_notes: One idea: the prime factors of a cube split into three equal groups, and one group multiplied out is the cube root. Watch for students who multiply all the prime factors together instead of one group.

video_script.why: The child finds the cube roots of two large numbers by splitting their prime factors into three equal groups, as the solved example did.
video_script.substitution: Write the number as prime factors, split them into three equal groups, multiply one group, and cube the result to check.
video_script.anchor: two number cards, twenty seven thousand and ten thousand six hundred forty eight
video_script.payoff_line: The cube roots are thirty and twenty two
video_script.design: One idea: three equal groups of prime factors, one group is the root. The two number cards stay in the anchor band and each factor list sits on the working board.

narration: <bookmark mark='groups'/>We find a cube root by splitting prime factors into three equal groups.
<bookmark mark='one'/>Sixty four splits into three groups of two times two, so its cube root is four.
<bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the numbers twenty seven thousand and ten thousand six hundred forty eight.

beats.on_screen: To find: the cube root of each

marks.find: the thing to find is written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the cube root of each number.

marks.group: the factors are circled in three equal groups of 3, 2 and 5
marks.root: one group 3 × 2 × 5 = 30 is written as the cube root

narration: <bookmark mark='split'/>Step one, split twenty seven thousand into twenty seven and one thousand.
<bookmark mark='primes'/>That gives three threes, three twos and three fives.
<bookmark mark='group'/>Each of the three equal groups holds a three, a two and a five.
<bookmark mark='root'/>Three times two times five is thirty, so the cube root of twenty seven thousand is thirty.

marks.halve: 10648 is halved three times to reach 1331
marks.eleven: 1331 is divided by 11 three times to reach 1
marks.group: the factors are circled in three equal groups of 2 and 11
marks.root: one group 2 × 11 = 22 is written as the cube root

narration: <bookmark mark='halve'/>Step two, halve ten thousand six hundred forty eight three times. That leaves one thousand three hundred thirty one.
<bookmark mark='eleven'/>Dividing that by eleven three times reaches one.
<bookmark mark='group'/>Each of the three equal groups holds a two and an eleven.
<bookmark mark='root'/>Two times eleven is twenty two, so the cube root is twenty two.

marks.back: the words put the answers back in the question are written

narration: <bookmark mark='back'/>Step three, put the answers back in the question.
<bookmark mark='thirty'/>Thirty times thirty is nine hundred, and nine hundred times thirty is twenty seven thousand.
<bookmark mark='twentytwo'/>Twenty two times twenty two is four hundred eighty four.
Four hundred eighty four times twenty two is ten thousand six hundred forty eight.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>The cube roots are thirty and twenty two.
